title: Filling up of vacant posts (Group “A”, Group “B” and Group “C”) in IPC- regarding.
bodyHtml: Applications are invited, for filling up of the following posts through Direct Recruitment Basis and Deputation (Including Short Term Contract) Basis from the competent, dedicated, and dynamic citizens of India who fulfill the eligibility criteria and other details in the prescribed format which may be downloaded from the website of the Commission.PDF (opens in a new tab)
